title: lakmisa num tiya
intro: der udduruuk naharal, sahdayti baxi aydaaduk naharsi ayroorah addat, namma rooci sinni gineh foocal fida luk soolen. Tiya oggolimteh, tiya masuginna. macaay kataytam akkele naharsi kaxxa rooka toobokoh fanat- inki abto lakmisa marih waaso kee inki abto qeero canê gacsi. Anu miyya kinniyom atu baxxaqissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu oobokem seehadayti baxi ardi bagul suge qemmoh ayroora
Anu ta ardi bagul gexeh yan naharsi nammaytakkoh awkah suge
Anu inki adda fida kah xayyoowem yi gineenah ruffa axce gidih tayse
Yi xayyos dagal oggolimeh, yi toobokoh xayyos cinnimteh
Rabi meysisso yoo tekke wak, Anu inni toobokoh amol gaba ugse waam doorite
Anu qemmoh num ekke seehadayti baxi aydaadul hoxat gersi num qide

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Sehdayti baxi aydaadul qimboh addah qidimih madluum yekke
coox merraytih addat kaxxa weeqi cattiimeh
Jinniiy, seehadayti baxaa kee caacay miraacisak suge.
morootom liggiditteh fidin garboh addat meekite
outcome.answer: Sehdayti baxi aydaadul qimboh addah qidimih madluum yekke

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
